info.name: BookMyShow - Shows API
info.description: Test collection for Shows API endpoints

item.name: Health Check
item.description: Basic health check to verify server is running

item.name: Get All Movies
item.description: Get paginated list of all movies (first 10 by default)

item.name: Get Movie by ID
item.description: Get detailed information about a specific movie. Replace the UUID with an actual movie ID from your database.

item.name: Get Shows by Movie (All Dates)
Get Shows by Movie (Specific Date)
item.description: Get shows for a movie on a specific date. Date must be today or in the future (YYYY-MM-DD format)

item.name: Get Show Details (by ID)
item.description: Get detailed information about a specific show (includes seat summary, time until show, etc.). This endpoint is called when you click 'Book Now' on a show card.

item.name: Get Show Seat Layout
item.description: Get the complete seat layout for a show. Returns seats grouped by row with their availability status.

item.name: Block Seats
item.description: Temporarily block seats for the booking process (5-minute hold by default). Requires valid seat UUIDs from the seat layout response.
